g.text: Capture human actions, intent, and device evidence in one timeline
Local recording · Local speech recognition · Reusable output
Clicks, swipes, input, and real device state
Spoken rationale, business intent, and caveats
No need to restate the flow
Every step preserves the context before the action
Align user intent with real actions
Teach once, preserve twice: stable facts become knowledge; verified flows become repeatable tests.
